pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 5 units from Mustafar into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Mustafar remains a possible base location.
